items.claim: Broadcom guides Q1 FY26 AI semiconductor revenue to roughly double year-on-year.
items.quote: our AI revenue to double year-on-year to $8.2 billion
items.speaker: Hock Tan

items.claim: CFO guides Q1 consolidated gross margin down sequentially on higher AI mix.
items.quote: down approximately 100 basis points sequentially
items.speaker: Kirsten Spears

items.claim: Board raises quarterly dividend 10% to $0.65/share for FY26.
items.quote: an increase of 10% from the prior quarter
items.speaker: Kirsten Spears

items.claim: Total AI-related order backlog (XPUs, switches, DSPs, lasers) exceeds $73B for delivery over 18 months.
items.quote: total order on hand in excess of $73 billion today
items.speaker: Hock Tan

items.claim: AI switch order backlog (Tomahawk 6) exceeds $10B.
items.quote: order backlog for AI switches exceeds $10 billion
items.speaker: Hock Tan

items.claim: Broadcom secured a fifth XPU customer via a $1B order for late-2026 delivery.
items.quote: acquired a fifth XPU customer through a $1 billion order
items.speaker: Hock Tan

items.claim: Hock dismisses the idea that hyperscalers will bring XPU tooling fully in-house as overstated.
items.quote: this concept of customer tooling is an overblown hypothesis
items.speaker: Hock Tan

items.claim: Non-AI semiconductor demand described as stable, not yet in a sustainable recovery outside broadband.
items.quote: We don't see a sharp recovery that is sustainable yet
items.speaker: Hock Tan

items.claim: Management expects gross margin % to decline with AI/system mix but gross margin dollars and operating margin dollars to rise.
items.quote: gross margin dollars will go up, margins will go down
items.speaker: Kirsten Spears

items.claim: Share repurchase authorization extended, $7.5B remaining capacity through end of CY2026.
items.quote: $7.5 billion remains, through the end of calendar year 2026
items.speaker: Kirsten Spears

items.claim: 2026 outlook: non-AI semiconductor revenue expected to be stable while AI drives growth.
items.quote: non-AI semiconductor revenue to be stable
items.speaker: Hock Tan

items.claim: Hock explicitly declines to confirm or deny that the $1B fifth-customer order is OpenAI.
items.quote: I did not answer it and I'm not answering it either
items.speaker: Hock Tan

items.claim: Silicon photonics acknowledged as a future direction but not near-term ready for deployment.
items.quote: We're not quite there yet
items.speaker: Hock Tan

items.claim: Q2 FY26 consolidated revenue guided to approximately $22 billion.
items.quote: consolidated revenue of approximately $22 billion
items.speaker: Hock Tan

items.claim: Q2 AI semiconductor revenue growth guided to accelerate sharply to 140% y/y.
items.quote: accelerate very sharply to 140% year-on-year
items.speaker: Hock Tan

items.claim: Google demand cited as strong for the 7th-gen Ironwood TPU, expected to strengthen further from 2027.
items.quote: strong demand for the seventh-generation Ironwood TPU
items.speaker: Hock Tan

items.claim: Anthropic 2027 TPU compute demand expected to surge past 3 gigawatts.
items.quote: surge in excess of 3 gigawatts of compute
items.speaker: Hock Tan

items.claim: Hock pushes back on analyst reports questioning Meta's MTIA custom accelerator roadmap.
items.quote: Meta's custom accelerator MTIA road map is alive and well
items.speaker: Hock Tan

items.claim: OpenAI named as sixth XPU customer, expected to deploy first-gen XPU at 1GW+ scale in 2027.
items.quote: OpenAI deploying in volume their first-generation XPU
items.speaker: Hock Tan

items.claim: Broadcom states it has fully secured key component supply (wafers, HBM, substrate) for '26 through '28.
items.quote: secured capacity of these components for '26 through '28
items.speaker: Hock Tan

items.claim: Broadcom states line of sight to AI chip revenue exceeding $100B in 2027.
items.quote: in excess of $100 billion in 2027
items.speaker: Hock Tan

items.claim: AI networking revenue grew 60% y/y in Q1, about a third of total AI revenue.
items.quote: Q1 AI networking revenue grew 60% year-on-year
items.speaker: Hock Tan

items.claim: Management positions infrastructure software (VMware/VCF) as insulated from AI-driven disruption.
items.quote: our Infrastructure Software is not disrupted by AI
items.speaker: Hock Tan

items.claim: Board authorizes an additional $10B for the share repurchase program through end of CY2026.
items.quote: an additional $10 billion for our share repurchase program
items.speaker: Kirsten Spears

items.claim: Q1 capital return: $10.9B returned to shareholders via dividends and buybacks.
items.quote: returned $10.9 billion to shareholders
items.speaker: Kirsten Spears

items.claim: Hock states Broadcom will not see meaningful COT (customer-owned tooling) competition for years.
items.quote: we will not see competition in COT for many years to come
items.speaker: Hock Tan

items.claim: Hock forcefully rejects the premise that rack/system sales will structurally compress AI gross margin.
items.quote: Hate to tell you that you must be a bit hallucinating
items.speaker: Hock Tan

items.claim: Charlie Kawwas notes multiyear supply security is built on deep multiyear custom-silicon engagements with 6 customers.
items.quote: we build custom silicon for 6 customers
items.speaker: Charlie Kawwas

items.claim: Q3 FY26 AI semiconductor revenue guided to accelerate to $16B, up over 200% y/y.
items.quote: AI semiconductor revenue to accelerate to $16 billion
items.speaker: Hock Tan

items.claim: FY26 AI semiconductor revenue guided to $56 billion, up ~180% from FY25.
items.quote: AI semiconductor revenue of $56 billion
items.speaker: Hock Tan

items.claim: Broadcom reiterates FY27 AI semiconductor revenue guidance in excess of $100 billion.
items.quote: in excess of $100 billion
items.speaker: Hock Tan

items.claim: Google long-term agreement (announced April) covers multiple generations of TPUs and AI networking.
items.quote: agreement to develop and supply multiple generations
items.speaker: Hock Tan

items.claim: Anthropic agreement adds access to another 5 gigawatts of next-gen TPU compute starting 2027.
items.quote: another 5 gigawatts of next-generation TPU-based compute
items.speaker: Hock Tan

items.claim: OpenAI has a contractual commitment to deploy 1.3 gigawatts in 2027 within the larger 10GW-by-2029 deal.
items.quote: contractual commitment to deploy 1.3 gigawatts in 2027
items.speaker: Hock Tan

items.claim: Meta agreement calls for deploying 3 gigawatts of MTIA capacity through end of 2028.
items.quote: expect to deploy 3 gigawatts through the end of 2028
items.speaker: Hock Tan

items.claim: Broadcom positions its CPO/optical DSP and laser technology as the de facto industry standard.
items.quote: we are the de facto standard in the industry
items.speaker: Hock Tan

items.claim: New AI XPV platform with Apollo/Blackstone targets deploying over 20 gigawatts of compute capacity through 2028.
items.quote: more than 20 gigawatts of compute capacity through 2028
items.speaker: Hock Tan

items.claim: First tranche of the XPV financing platform valued at $35 billion, being launched by Apollo.
items.quote: The first tranche of this platform valued at $35 billion
items.speaker: Hock Tan

items.claim: Management frames Q3 gross margin decline to ~74% as mix-driven, not a structural semiconductor margin change.
items.quote: does not represent a structural change
items.speaker: Kirsten Spears

items.claim: Management recommends modeling semiconductor and infrastructure software margins separately going forward.
items.quote: semiconductor and infrastructure software margins separately
items.speaker: Kirsten Spears

items.claim: Non-AI semiconductor bookings above $6B cited as a sign of a fuller cyclical recovery underway.
items.quote: on the path towards a full cyclical recovery
items.speaker: Hock Tan

items.claim: VCF 9.1 adds heterogeneous compute support spanning AMD, Intel and NVIDIA platforms.
items.quote: compute support across GPUs and CPU architectures
items.speaker: Hock Tan

items.claim: Hock says supply-chain visibility has extended out to 2028, up from 2027 three months earlier.
items.quote: Our visibility runs all the way to 2028 right now
items.speaker: Hock Tan

items.claim: CFO Kirsten Spears announced as retiring June 12, with Amie Thuener joining as incoming CFO.
items.quote: Kirsten will be retiring June 12
items.speaker: Ji Yoo

qa_flags.question: whether the $1 billion fifth-customer order is indeed OpenAI
qa_flags.response_pattern: explicitly declines to confirm or deny ('I did not answer it and I'm not answering it either')

qa_flags.question: whether the OpenAI 10-gigawatt announcement is a binding agreement similar to NVIDIA/AMD deals
qa_flags.response_pattern: does not directly confirm or deny bindingness; reframes as an 'agreement and alignment' for 2027-2029 and downplays 2026 contribution

qa_flags.question: how much of the Anthropic deal dollar value is chips versus racks
qa_flags.response_pattern: explicitly declines to break out the split, redirects to 'we're good on our dollars and margin'

qa_flags.question: whether the OpenAI ramp (10GW by 2029) implies a sharp inflection in 2028
qa_flags.response_pattern: long strategic narrative response about customer commitment and visibility without directly confirming or quantifying the 2028 inflection

qa_flags.question: the total dollar value of the long-term Google TPU/networking agreement and whether it is fixed or share-based
qa_flags.response_pattern: declines to give a number, repeats vague superlative language ('very, very substantial amount of dollars') without specifics

qa_flags.question: whether the rack-versus-chip revenue mix question is now fully clarified
qa_flags.response_pattern: curt repeated denial ('No racks... We're in the chip business only... Only chips') that reads as a shift from the prior quarter's 'system sale' / rack-selling language
